meta.title: NYC city fleet EV chargers
meta.dataset: NYC Open Data, DCAS Citywide Fleet EV Charging Stations (fc53-9hrv)
meta.count_unit: Popup totals show chargers (dataset rows at the location) and ports (the no_of_ports field). Both are stored.

levels.L3: Type names containing Level 3 or Fast (Level 3 Fast Charger, DOT Municipal Level 3 Charger).
levels.L2: Type names containing Level 2, L2, or Flo (Level 2 Charger, L2 DOT Flo Curbside Charger, DOT Municipal Level 2 Charger). EV Solar Arc Charger is also counted as L2 because those NYC fleet units are typically Level 2.
levels.other: EV Solar Canopy Charger and Mobile Charger are labeled by type, not assigned L1/L2/L3.

meta.grouping: Rows are merged when published coordinates are within 25 m, or when they share a normalized street + postcode and are within 75 m. The same address is not merged across distant points (for example two 80 Henry Street sites more than a kilometer apart stay separate).

dropped.note: 318 rows had no latitude/longitude and were omitted (locations are never invented). That includes every Upstate and Westchester row in this extract, plus some five-borough and unlocated mobile units. Upstate and Westchester sites would be shown if coordinates were published, because fleet drivers travel there. 0 rows had coordinates outside the New York area.
